description: A Dart source file defining the MedicalRecordService class, which provides methods to interact with the 'medical_records' table via Supabase in a Flutter app. It includes methods to list, retrieve, create, and delete medical records based on patient ID or record ID.

classes.name: MedicalRecordService
classes.description: A service class providing CRUD operations for medical records stored in a database table named 'medical_records'.

methods.name: listForPatient
methods.description: Retrieves a list of medical records associated with a specific patient ID, ordered by creation date descending.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a single medical record by its unique ID, or null if not found.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new medical record in the database and returns the created record.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a medical record by its ID.
